title: Marriage Toxin
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Hikaru Gero, heir to a clan of poison assassins, must produce an heir or his grandmother will force his little sister Akari into marriage. He enlists his would-be target, Mei Kinosaki, a male marriage swindler who poses as a woman, to coach him in dating. Their matchmaking jobs keep colliding with rival assassin clans, mixing romantic comedy and superpowered fights.
life_message: It holds up protecting family and learning to love openly, even for someone raised to kill.
